data.title: ScienceDaily: Keto diet slashes liver fat by 67% in just 4 months
data.summary: A new clinical trial found that the ketogenic diet dramatically outperformed Mediterranean and low-fat diets in reducing liver fat and improving metabolic health, even when participants lost similar amounts of weight. data.title: ScienceDaily: Scientists turn Moon dust into LEGO-like bricks for future lunar bases

data.title: ScienceDaily: CERN scientists finally find evidence of a particle decay so rare it took 40 years to detect

data.title: ScienceDaily: For better mental health, how often you exercise may matter more than how hard
data.summary: A study of more than 10,000 college students found that exercising regularly may be more important for mental health than pushing yourself through intense or lengthy workouts. data.title: ScienceDaily: Two massive stars may be secretly feeding the Milky Way’s supermassive black hole

data.title: ScienceDaily: Microplastics may be more dangerous than we thought. Scientists just discovered why
data.summary: Microplastics may be doing something far more dangerous than simply accumulating in our bodies. Scientists have discovered that tiny plastic particles can interact with water to generate highly reactive molecules capable of damaging cells and tissues. data.title: ScienceDaily: After 8 years in space, a groundbreaking X-ray telescope finally opens its eyes

data.title: ScienceDaily: A decades-old mystery about light could hold the key to faster internet

data.title: ScienceDaily: A 50-year-old theory about evolution may have been wrong all along
data.summary: A decades-old theory suggesting that evolution protects its most important genes from mutations has been dealt a major blow. data.title: ScienceDaily: Common medications may secretly rewire your gut, with effects lasting for years
data.summary: Medications taken years or even long ago may leave lasting changes in your gut microbiome, according to a study of more than 2,500 people. data.title: ScienceDaily: Type 2 diabetes linked to 53% higher Alzheimer’s risk, major review finds
data.summary: People with type 2 diabetes face a 53% higher risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease, according to a major new review of 40 studies. By focusing specifically on these two conditions, the study offers a clearer understanding of a potentially serious connection between metabolic health and brain health.

data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11341-6
Dental morphology and proteomic analyses of fossils from southern China identify lineages with and without Denisovan affinity, indicating the diversity of hominin populations in this region in the Middle to Late Pleistocene.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Middle–Late Pleistocene Denisovans and unresolved Homo in southern China

data.title: Nature: Sustainable cement production via a liquid-phase pathway
data.author: Paulo J. M. Monteiro
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11313-w
Sustainable cement production can be achieved by accelerating its reaction kinetics through a microwave carbon-plasma method, reducing the standard processing time from hours to seconds.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Sustainable cement production via a liquid-phase pathway

data.title: Nature: Context-dependent response of endothelial cells to PIK3CA mutation
data.author: Mariona Graupera
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11318-5
Expression of PIK3CAH1047R in arterial precursors disrupts arterial differentiation and promotes the acquisition of venous features.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Context-dependent response of endothelial cells to PIK3CA mutation

data.title: Nature: Augmenting reality with integrated photonics
data.author: Giuseppe Calafiore
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11146-7
Integrated photonics could overcome key size, power and performance trade-offs in augmented-reality glasses, enabling compact, efficient displays while opening opportunities across quantum computing, bioimaging and optical sensing.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Augmenting reality with integrated photonics

data.title: Nature: Enzymatic living polymerization for polysaccharide synthesis
data.author: Guosong Chen
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11304-x
An enzymatic method for making high-molecular-weight polysaccharides in a way similar to synthetic polymerization techniques, rather than biosynthetically, is presented.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Enzymatic living polymerization for polysaccharide synthesis

data.title: Nature: Coherent parity oscillations in coupled minimal Kitaev chains
data.author: Leo P. Kouwenhoven
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11309-6
Coherent time-resolved rotations between parity states encoded by four poor man’s Majoranas are demonstrated in two coupled minimal Kitaev chains, providing a foundation for topologically protected qubits in longer chains.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Coherent parity oscillations in coupled minimal Kitaev chains

data.title: Nature: Transcription from megabase-scale heterochromatin generates neural barcodes
data.author: Daniele Canzio
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11311-y
Interrogation of the clustered protocadherin locus shows an unexpected ability of genes to transcribe within a seemingly silent chromatin environment.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Transcription from megabase-scale heterochromatin generates neural barcodes

data.title: Nature: Structural basis of RNA-guided DNA integration by type I CAST systems
data.author: Martin Jinek
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11196-x
Structural analyses reveal the mechanism underlying RNA-guided DNA integration by type I CRISPR-associated transposases (CASTs) and provide a framework for developing CASTs into site-specific genome-editing tools.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Structural basis of RNA-guided DNA integration by type I CAST systems

data.title: Nature: Clinical landscape of cardiometabolic heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
data.author: Joseph A. Hill
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11231-x
This Review covers the current state of research into heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) from a variety of perspectives, focusing on the clinical context.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Clinical landscape of cardiometabolic heart failure with preserved ejection fraction

data.title: Nature: An extremophile transgene improves drought resistance and yield in cereals
data.author: Hude Mao
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11151-w
The use of an extremophile fungus-derived gene decouples the trade-off of drought stress and reduced crop yield by boosting drought resilience and increasing yields in wheat, rice and maize.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: An extremophile transgene improves drought resistance and yield in cereals

data.title: Nature: Disturbances and climate drive tree elevational shifts
data.author: Songlin Fei
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11354-1
Climate change and natural disturbances are key drivers of tree abundance dynamics: warming tends to shift tree abundance upslope whereas major disturbances, such as wildfires and insect outbreaks, tend to shift it downslope, creating opposing pressures on tree species’ elevational redistribution.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Disturbances and climate drive tree elevational shifts

data.title: Nature: Unconventional resistivity reduction in NbP semimetal nanoribbons
data.author: Eric Pop
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11288-8
Niobium phosphide semimetal nanoribbons show decreasing resistivity with decreasing width, unlike the classical behaviour of metals such as copper, offering a platform for nanoscale wires and interconnects via industry-friendly top-down nanofabrication.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Unconventional resistivity reduction in NbP semimetal nanoribbons

data.title: Nature: De novo design of high-potency dual-target therapeutic peptides with ORIDTP
data.author: Jianhua Yao
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11338-1
The artificial intelligence platform ORIDTP enabled de novo design of potent dual-target therapeutic peptides, generating candidate anti-obesity, antidiabetic and anticancer peptides with strong in vivo efficacy and broad cross-target generalizability.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: De novo design of high-potency dual-target therapeutic peptides with ORIDTP

data.title: Nature: Engineering signalling centres to trigger human trunk morphogenesis in vitro
data.author: Sharad Ramanathan
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11326-5
A high-throughput synthetic embryology platform reveals how transient spatial cues establish two self-sustaining signalling centres that organize trunk-like morphogenesis, enabling the study of early human development and congenital disorders.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Engineering signalling centres to trigger human trunk morphogenesis in vitro

data.title: Nature: Rare-variant genetic architecture of height in over 1.4 million individuals
data.author: Taka Yamaguchi
data.summary:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11345-2

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Rare-variant genetic architecture of height in over 1.4 million individuals

data.title: Nature: Submillimetre hot-electron transport in manganese-doped quantum dot solids
data.author: Victor I. Klimov

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.label: Nature: Submillimetre hot-electron transport in manganese-doped quantum dot solids
